svg.title: Pale Blue Dot
svg.desc: Earth as a mote of dust suspended in a sunbeam, after Carl Sagan. A starfield with one diagonal shaft of light and a single pale blue dot, with Sagan's meditation and a call to kindness.

text.tspan: That's here. That's home. That's us.
Every human being who ever was
lived out their lives on it —
on a mote of dust suspended in a sunbeam.

svg.text: Be kind to one another. Everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.
